gap.en: Historical8.0.46 V2/HA evidence is not current full V3 acceptance.

acceptance.zh-CN: 对本次发布包补验多库多目标、类型/生成列、事务、主备/MGR、失败恢复与人工操作；按拓扑和小版本注明范围。
acceptance.en: Reverify current-release multi-database fan-out,types/generated columns,transactions,ASYNC/MGR,recovery/manual operations with explicit patch/topology scope.

title.zh-CN: MySQL 8.2 新增兼容与验收

gap.zh-CN: 未发现8.2专用完整真实验收记录，不能用8.0/8.4代替。
gap.en: No dedicated complete8.2 native evidence found;8.0/8.4 cannot substitute.

acceptance.zh-CN: 提供可复现8.2夹具/真实环境、版本探测、连接认证、状态命令、binlog事件和首个完整同步/恢复矩阵；不能只增加版本字符串或通过JDBC连接。
acceptance.en: Provide reproducible8.2 environment,version/auth/status/binlog handling and a complete first sync/recovery matrix;string matching/JDBC connectivity alone is insufficient.

title.zh-CN: MySQL 8.4 扩展兼容与回归

gap.zh-CN: 8.4已有代表性V3/恢复证据，但不是所有日志特性、认证、拓扑和目标组合。
gap.en: Representative8.4 V3/recovery evidence is not every log/auth/topology/destination combination.

acceptance.zh-CN: 在当前发布包复验已支持档案，列明未标记/带标记GTID、匿名事务、行镜像、压缩/部分JSON等能力支持或拒绝，不把版本名称等同所有特性完成。
acceptance.en: Reverify supported current-release profiles and declare tagged/untagged GTID,anonymous events,row images,compression/partial-JSON capabilities or refusal;version labels are not blanket feature acceptance.

title.zh-CN: PostgreSQL 源适配器

gap.zh-CN: 能力目录仅PLANNED，PG目标驱动不等于PG源。
gap.en: Catalog says PLANNED;a PG sink driver is not a PG source.

acceptance.zh-CN: 完成一致性快照与LSN衔接、逻辑复制槽/发布、事务顺序/重复去重、Replica Identity前镜像、类型/DDL及故障恢复；槽/WAL丢失和切主按确切版本验证；GUI/CLI/文档可用。
acceptance.en: Implement consistent snapshot/LSN handoff,slots/publications,ordering/replay,replica identity,types/DDL and recovery;verify WAL/slot loss/promotion per version;expose GUI/CLI/docs.

title.zh-CN: Oracle 源适配器

gap.zh-CN: 能力目录仅PLANNED，尚无原生全量/增量实现。
gap.en: Catalog says PLANNED;no native snapshot/CDC implementation.

acceptance.zh-CN: 确定并记录LogMiner/XStream等路线、版本/权限/驱动分发条件；实现SCN一致性快照、提交/回滚、redo/归档、DBID/incarnation识别、断点与重复恢复，逐项验证LOB、字符集、PDB/RAC等范围。
acceptance.en: Specify capture route,versions,privileges and driver distribution conditions;implement SCN snapshot,commit/rollback,redo/archive,DB identity/incarnation,checkpoint/replay;verify LOB,charset,PDB/RAC scope explicitly.

title.zh-CN: Java 8/11/17/21/25 可运行发布

gap.zh-CN: 主代码Java8兼容且有旧包10项SQL矩阵，当前全功能发布未覆盖。
gap.en: Java8 baseline and an older ten-profile SQL matrix exist;current full release is not covered.

acceptance.zh-CN: 同一候选版本的控制器/Agent/Worker分别在五个JDK实际启动，报告真实JVM版本、包SHA、架构与所用依赖；Java8代码级别和驱动运行要求可核验。
acceptance.en: The candidate controller/agent/worker actually starts on all five JDKs with real JVM version,artifact hash,architecture and dependencies recorded;Java8 class/driver requirements are verified.

title.zh-CN: 源/目标/恢复跨JDK矩阵

gap.zh-CN: 已有十项只覆盖单主键ASCII表和PG目标，不覆盖全部连接器。
gap.en: Ten profiles cover one keyed ASCII table/PG sink,not all adapters.

acceptance.zh-CN: 每个批准的源档案与五JDK至少验证全量、增量、重启和内容一致；目标驱动、消息SDK、TLS、JSON/无主键、集群、修复/跳过单独登记，未跑不得标记通过。
acceptance.en: Each approved source profile crosses five JDKs for snapshot,CDC,restart and equality;record separate adapter/SDK/TLS/object/cluster/recovery gates and never label unrun combinations passed.

title.zh-CN: 驱动隔离、依赖与安全协议兼容

gap.zh-CN: 已有厂商SDK隔离和完整包检查，缺全部JDK组合验证。
gap.en: Vendor isolation/artifact checks exist without all-JDK coverage.

acceptance.zh-CN: 验证服务加载、反射/模块限制、认证/TLS/证书、连接重建、精度和厂商驱动最低JDK；不可兼容组合在预检和矩阵明确拒绝，不能只靠编译通过。
acceptance.en: Verify service loading,reflection/modules,auth/TLS/certificates,reconnect,precision and vendor minimum JDK;incompatible combinations are explicitly refused,not inferred from compilation.

title.zh-CN: 多JDK部署及混合版本升级

gap.zh-CN: 现有基准可选JRE，生产发布/集群升级策略未完整验收。
gap.en: Benchmarks select JREs;production/mixed-cluster upgrade policies are not accepted.

acceptance.zh-CN: 提供五JDK部署档案和能力调度限制，验证混合节点间命令/事件/状态兼容与滚动升级；不支持回退时明确拒绝并保留恢复路径。
acceptance.en: Provide five-JDK deployment profiles/placement constraints and verify command,event,state and rolling-upgrade compatibility;unsupported downgrade is refused with recovery guidance.

title.zh-CN: 双语SDD基线与范围可追踪

gap.zh-CN: 本轮建立v0.1基线；详细模块设计、规格变更管理和实现证据闭环仍需完成。
gap.en: This change creates the v0.1 inventory;module designs,spec change control and implementation evidence closure remain open.

acceptance.zh-CN: 每项需求有稳定ID、现状、未完成点、依赖、优先级、验收和任务；中英文ID一致；规格变化有记录，旧验收不可冒充新范围通过。
acceptance.en: Each requirement has stable ID,status,gap,dependencies,priority,acceptance and task;ZH/EN IDs match and changes preserve evidence scope.

title.zh-CN: 四类部署与多节点运维文档

gap.zh-CN: 现有Linux/Docker/Helm/原生K8s文件未覆盖新集群控制与会话模型。
gap.en: Existing deployment artifacts do not cover new cluster control/session models.

acceptance.zh-CN: 提供单机及多节点四类可运行示例，说明控制/日志/会话/报告存储、Secret/TLS、节点注册排空、备份恢复升级和无独立存储边界；K8s实机另有证据。
acceptance.en: Provide runnable standalone/cluster examples for four deployment paths with stores,secrets/TLS,enrollment/drain,backup/restore/upgrades and local-storage boundaries;live K8s requires separate evidence.

title.zh-CN: 恢复场景和FAQ完整手册

gap.zh-CN: 现有校验/共同点修复FAQ不能覆盖新跳过、补数据与跨节点故障。
gap.en: Existing reconciliation FAQ does not cover new skip,patch and distributed faults.

acceptance.zh-CN: 逐场景描述现象、原因、界面/API操作、执行前后断点、缺口、幂等/撤销边界；覆盖源切主、日志丢失、SQL错误、确认丢失、节点/存储故障、会话撤销和人工恢复。
acceptance.en: Each scenario states symptoms,cause,UI/API steps,positions,gaps,idempotency/undo limits across promotion,log loss,SQL/ack,node/storage,session and manual recovery.

title.zh-CN: 配置/API/兼容性与升级文档

gap.zh-CN: 已有部分手册，缺新接口与统一源/目标/JDK档案索引。
gap.en: Partial handbooks lack new APIs and a unified profile index.

acceptance.zh-CN: 配置字段、权限、状态码、请求/命令/计划版本、Source坐标、目标一致性及源×目标×JDK矩阵都有对应样例和实测状态；增加或改字段同时更新双语文档。
acceptance.en: Document configuration,grants,codes,request/command/plan versions,source coordinates,consistency and source/sink/JDK profiles with examples/evidence;schema changes update both languages.

title.zh-CN: 文档和证据发布门禁

gap.zh-CN: 已有验收归档/哈希及预览检查，缺覆盖所有需求的统一门禁。
gap.en: Archives/hash/preview checks exist without a complete requirement release gate.

acceptance.zh-CN: 链接/配置示例/API/中英文覆盖检查通过；每个完成项关联候选包SHA及真实环境证据；DOM不代替视觉，静态YAML不代替实机，构建通过不代替适配器验收。
acceptance.en: Check links,examples,APIs and bilingual coverage;completion links candidate hash/native evidence;DOM is not visual,static YAML is not live deployment,and builds are not adapter acceptance.

title.zh-CN: 国产事务库兼容矩阵

gap.zh-CN: openGauss/达梦/金仓/GBase8c为首批档案；分布式GaussDB、OceanBase完整恢复及GBase8a/8s等未完成。
gap.en: Initial openGauss/DM/Kingbase/GBase8c profiles exist;distributed GaussDB,complete OceanBase recovery and GBase8a/8s remain open.

acceptance.zh-CN: 按产品/版本/模式/分布键/索引/驱动/JDK记录完整同步恢复及补偿/跳过能力；商业分布式实机单独验收，不能以PG协议连通替代。
acceptance.en: Record sync/recovery/manual capabilities by product,version,mode,distribution/index/driver/JDK;commercial distributed hardware is separately accepted,not inferred from PG protocol connectivity.

title.zh-CN: 非空接管、约束恢复、切换回切

gap.zh-CN: 当前首用目标要求为空，修复成功也不是业务切换完成。
gap.en: Initial destinations must be empty;repair completion is not cutover.

acceptance.zh-CN: 实现非空目标差异计划/校验、UNIQUE等约束重建、最终源屏障、业务写入交接及回切条件；双写/双向复制单独定义，不隐含承诺无冲突。
acceptance.en: Implement adoption/difference planning,constraint restoration,final source cut,write handoff and failback conditions;dual-write/bidirectional conflict policy is separately specified.

title.zh-CN: ClickHouse/Doris/Hive生产档案

gap.zh-CN: 首批物化/恢复已有证据，集群/TLS/权限/容量/全部JDK和新恢复语义未完成。
gap.en: Initial materialization/recovery exists;cluster/security/capacity/JDK/new recovery profiles remain open.

acceptance.zh-CN: 各产品按真实可见水位、去重/批次回执验证重启、旧备份、集群故障和缺口；不能承诺普通SQL跨表事务语义。
acceptance.en: Verify visibility,dedup/batch receipts,restart,old-backup,cluster and gaps per product without claiming ordinary SQL cross-table atomicity.

title.zh-CN: 全部消息目标的集群与恢复协议

gap.zh-CN: Kafka/Pulsar/RabbitMQ/RocketMQ/Classic/Artemis/Redis Streams/NATS JetStream已有首批传输，完整集群/TLS/容量仍缺。
gap.en: Initial transports exist for all confirmed queues;complete cluster/TLS/capacity coverage is open.

acceptance.zh-CN: 每个目标验证确认丢失、Broker选主、持久回执、资源丢失、消费者去重/积压以及新跳过缺口协议，明确至少一次及消费完成边界。
acceptance.en: Each queue verifies lost confirmations,election,durable receipts,resource loss,consumer dedup/backlog and skip-gap protocol with honest delivery/consumption boundaries.

title.zh-CN: 可选存储和跨节点数据可达性

gap.zh-CN: 已有本地/外部日志，但本地权威文件、报告、会话、控制元数据的迁移/HA边界不统一。
gap.en: Local/external journals exist;authority/reports/sessions/control-store relocation and HA boundaries are not unified.

acceptance.zh-CN: 无独立存储时明确持久卷/节点绑定与磁盘丢失边界；外部/共享存储按能力验收；跨节点迁移前验证日志、原事件、报告和密钥可达，不可只搬游标；不强制所有部署新增独立日志服务。
acceptance.en: Local mode documents durable volume/pinning/disk-loss limits;external/shared modes are accepted per capability;move verifies logs,evidence,reports and secrets,not just cursors;independent journal infrastructure is not mandatory for every deployment.

title.zh-CN: 真实K8s/CSI与节点故障验收

gap.zh-CN: Helm/原生清单通过静态检查，不能证明真实集群安全。
gap.en: Helm/native static checks do not establish live-cluster safety.

acceptance.zh-CN: 在真实集群验证升级、扩缩、Pod/节点故障、RWO/CSI挂载重连、Secret轮换及旧owner隔离，发布实际配置和证据。
acceptance.en: Verify upgrade/scale,pod/node failure,RWO/CSI remount,secret rotation and stale-owner fencing on a real cluster with published configuration/evidence.

title.zh-CN: 海量对象、大事务和硬件性能标准

gap.zh-CN: 有小规模基准工具，超大事务分片、目录分页、有界缓存与容量标准未完整完成。
gap.en: Small benchmark tools exist;large-transaction/catalog/cache/capacity standards remain incomplete.

acceptance.zh-CN: 限制内存/磁盘并处理大事务、海量表和慢目标；记录CPU/内存/磁盘/网络/负载与多轮结果，不线性外推，不以行数一致替代数据一致。
acceptance.en: Bound memory/disk for large transactions/catalogs/slow sinks and publish multi-run hardware/workload results without linear extrapolation or count-only correctness.

title.zh-CN: 历史DDL、类型、索引与状态迁移

gap.zh-CN: 已有白名单对象和UNIQUE/GSI转换；完整动态DDL、复杂类型及备份恢复档案仍缺。首版不支持旧开发候选兼容。
gap.en: Supported objects and UNIQUE/GSI conversion exist;full dynamic DDL,complex types and backup/restore profiles remain open. The first release does not retain prerelease-candidate compatibility.

acceptance.zh-CN: 对象变化保留源schema历史和审阅计划，身份键不降级；首版状态结构直接创建，不兼容旧开发候选；验证当前状态的备份恢复、损坏拒绝及各产品限制。
acceptance.en: Preserve source schema history,reviewed plans and identity keys;create first-release state directly without prerelease-candidate compatibility;verify current-state backup/restore,corruption refusal and product-specific limits.

title.zh-CN: 报告目录、保留清理与真实浏览器验收

gap.zh-CN: 已有摘要/详情和DOM/HTTP，缺完整目录、scratch清理、视觉与可访问性证据。
gap.en: Summaries/details/DOM/HTTP exist;full catalogs,cleanup,visual/accessibility evidence do not.

acceptance.zh-CN: 提供授权报告/凭据检索、保留与活动文件保护；真实浏览器验证跨节点、刷新登录、计划确认、错误恢复和大表分页，补齐可访问性检查。
acceptance.en: Provide authorized report/receipt search,retention and active-file protection;real browsers verify cluster/session/confirmation/recovery/pagination and accessibility.

title.zh-CN: 外部身份、不可变审计与Apache准备
title.en: External identity,immutable audit and Apache preparation

gap.zh-CN: 本地账号及链式审计已有；OIDC/目录、外部审计锚点、许可证/NOTICE/SBOM/贡献流程仍缺。
gap.en: Local accounts/hash-chained audit exist;external identity/anchors,licenses/NOTICE/SBOM/contribution workflows remain open.

acceptance.zh-CN: 核验外部身份映射/撤销、外部审计留存和依赖分发条件，补齐许可证NOTICE/SBOM/贡献文档；Rivomesh不自称已获Apache身份或商标权。
acceptance.en: Verify external identity/revocation,external audit and distribution conditions;complete license/NOTICE/SBOM/contribution docs without claiming Apache affiliation or trademark rights.
